DIRECTOR BASE-SHA GUARD MISFIRES ON REPAIR RUNS (control-plane hardening item; .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from here). factory-director.yml records reports/director/BASE_DIRECTION_SHA_<run>.txt at the 'Record control-plane base' step AFTER 'Restore exact rejected proposal for repair', so on a repair run the recorded base is the REJECTED PROPOSAL's direction sha rather than main's. Verified in run 38786736419: the workflow-recorded value was 02351c26... (rejected proposal v52) while origin/main:state/factory_direction.json is 52f704ed... (v51, unchanged since run 38784614826 recorded exactly that value). On a PASS the integrate job compares the recorded base with main's current sha and would therefore skip integration with a spurious 'Superseded Director proposal' warning for EVERY repair round. Intended fix (owner/control-plane maintainer): record the base before restoring the rejected proposal, or inherit origin/<rejected-run>/reports/director/BASE_DIRECTION_SHA_<rejected-run>.txt on repair runs. Route-around used this round: the repair republished the TRUE control-plane base (52f704ed...) in its own BASE file and discloses both values in reports/director/RUN_38786736419.md; the supersession check still works as designed because main had not moved.

THE SUPERVISOR'S 'EXHAUSTED SAME-CHARTER WORK' GUARD IS DEAD CODE, BECAUSE jq's // OPERATOR TREATS LITERAL false AS EMPTY. Read at .github/workflows/factory-supervisor.yml:277 and reproduced locally with jq 1.7 this run: the guard evaluates `jq -r '.continue_recommended // true' <<<"$raw"` and compares the result to the string false, but `echo '{"continue_recommended":false}' | jq -r '.continue_recommended // true'` prints `true`, because jq's alternative operator falls through on false as well as on null. The guard can therefore NEVER fire, and any team whose lab/frontier/<team>.json says continue_recommended:false is re-dispatched forever. Observed live: frontier-counter-label-integrity was dispatched at 06:35Z (run 38862093221, cancelled) and again at 07:47Z (run 38869446783) while its accepted branch state already read charter_version 1, cycle_status TERMINATE, continue_recommended false -- producing at least nine no-change verification cycles and eight producer-authored audit placement copies. The identical pattern is on line 230 for the CORE lanes' .continue_recommended check, so a core lane can also be re-dispatched after it declares itself exhausted. .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from a lane, a team or the director. ROUTE-AROUND, and this is the standing rule rather than a one-off fix: the portfolio .status field is the ONLY reliable stop, because the dispatch query at line 261 is `select(.status=="RUN")`, a plain string comparison the jq defect does not touch. Set a discharged or exhausted team's status to TERMINATED; do not rely on continue_recommended, do not rely on a blocker file, and do not re-dispatch it. Intended upstream fix for the control-plane maintainer: test the field with `jq -r 'if .continue_recommended == false then "false" else "true" end'` (or `.continue_recommended | tostring`), never with //.

The inference rests on the auditor plan text for that run having printed 'Write reports/audit/product/CYCLE_38897640010.md and results/audit/product/CYCLE_38897640010_gate.json' (lowercase _gate). SET-IDENTITY CLAIMS ABOUT ACCEPTED EVIDENCE MUST BE VERIFIED AS SET RELATIONS, NEVER BY MATCHING CARDINALITIES. Verified this repair round (audit A-1 against director run 38906250297): reports/director/RUN_38906250297.md section 3 asserted, inside the table it heads 'every number recomputed this run from the accepted mount', that 'the 16 absent rows are exactly the 16 UNBACKED, supported=false rows'. Independent recomputation over the accepted artifact results/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/LABEL_HALF.json bundles[*].rows (n=65 = 25 de + 15 fr + 25 it) on (primary_defect_class, counter_evidence_verified, supported) gives ('OFF-DOMAIN', true, false) 38, ('SUPPORTED', true, true) 5, ('UNBACKED', None/absent, false) 16, ('UNBACKED', true, false) 6. So {counter_evidence_verified absent} = 16 while {primary_defect_class = UNBACKED AND supported = false} = 22: the absent set is a PROPER SUBSET, and the sentence also contradicted its own cell (which correctly reports UNBACKED 22). THE CORRECT STATEMENT, which is the correction of record: all 16 absent-verified rows are UNBACKED with supported=false, reason_code 'evidence_absent' and empty cited_evidence, at counter_uncertainty 0.95-1.0 (per bundle de 1 / fr 4 / it 11, the same partition the accepted canvas lock amber 1/4/11 measures); UNBACKED totals 22, and the other 6 carry counter_evidence_verified=true with 52-287 cited quotes and fail for CONTENT reasons instead (reason_code 'no_domain_anchor' 2, 'no_intent_marker' 4; counter_uncertainty 0.25-0.65). WHY IT IS NOT COSMETIC: the 16 are the evidence-plumbing class the accepted render fix addressed; the 6 are evidence-present-but-insufficient and need classifier work. Collapsing them implies every UNBACKED row is a missing-evidence row and hides the distinction on which product's rebuild-or-decline decision turns. STANDING RULE: before writing 'exactly', 'identical to' or 'all of the' between two counted sets of accepted rows, compute the intersection and both differences, never the two counts; a matching sub-count inside a larger count proves containment at best, never identity; and state WHICH field defines each set (bundle, row language, decision id) because per-bundle and per-row language partitions of the same 16 rows differ. PROVENANCE AND SUPERSESSION: RUN_38906250297.md is claim-bearing history and is NOT edited by the director (never overwrite a claim-bearing output; this repair round's declared scope is state/** plus its own report), so that clause is SUPERSEDED as of director run 38915705490 and is NOT claimable. The correction of record is this entry plus reports/director/RUN_38915705490.md sections 2-3, which govern wherever the two reports differ.

THE SUPERVISOR'S FRONTIER EXHAUSTION GUARD HAS TWO INDEPENDENT DEFECTS AND FAILS OPEN, SO IT STOPPED NOTHING FOR THREE DISPATCHES. Verified this run by reading .github/workflows/factory-supervisor.yml directly: the guard reads the lab-branch state with raw=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/contents/state/frontier/$team.json?ref=lab/frontier/$team" --jq '.content' | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null || true) and then requires [[ -n "$raw" ]] AND jq -r '.continue_recommended // true' == false. DEFECT 1 (already recorded as requirement 9): jq's // operator falls through on literal false as well as on null, so '.continue_recommended // true' can never print false and the guard can never fire on a genuinely exhausted team. DEFECT 2 (NEW, and the reason the guard is worse than dead code): the || true makes the fetch fail OPEN - a transient API failure, a secondary rate limit or any empty response yields empty raw, the non-empty test fails, and the code falls straight through to DISPATCH. So the guard does not merely fail to stop a terminated charter, it actively re-dispatches one whenever the API misbehaves.
